text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love?
Nah, haven't seen her.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ She hasn't come this way.
...Come to think of it, where does she usually hang out?

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... can't say I've seen anyone like that around.
...Trainer, you're drenched in sweat... Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Impatience and dread surged within me. Still in Love had looked completely unhinged.
Leaving her alone in that state felt incredibly dangerous.
choice_data_list: (Where are you... Where on earth did you go—)
(Where are you... Where on earth did you go—)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is a "crewmate."
That's why—I understand. I will "transmit."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"HRUP." Focus, "scoop it up."
"Her" "instinct." Close your eyes—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely.
"Feel for"—"Still in Love."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Driven by urgency, I strained my ears just as she said. And then, I "felt for" her... remembering that run, and those blood-red eyes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—My head aches. Static and whispers overwhelm my thoughts...
The sounds echoing in my mind gradually converge into one—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
C　　　　o　　　　m　　　　e
　　　　h　　　　　e　　　　r　　　　e

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enduring the throbbing headache, I followed the swelling clamor to its source...
There she was, all alone, writhing in agony.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...We should have just devoured them whole back then!
Sipping every last dripping drop... Ahhh—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how shameful...! No, please stop...
Why must you... Why...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. You love it too, deep down.
It's pointless to act so virtuous. I am... you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...No, you're wrong!! ...I'm not you...
You're... I'm... No, no, no...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...*gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... W-Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You searched for me... and found me...?
You came for me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!! I-I'm so sorry...
To let you see me in such a state...! It's utterly humiliating...
choice_data_list: ...Will you tell me about yourself? About "you"—
...Will you tell me about yourself? About "you"—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—It dwells within me.
A bloodline of madness... whispering to abandon all decency.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It first took root... No, I suppose it awakened.
The very first time I went to watch the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Races run with everything on the line... The fierce, breathtaking clash stole my heart away. I wanted to dive into that world too... Up to that point, I was completely normal.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...The final stretch. I felt the raw collision of pure instincts right against my skin.
At that very moment, chills ran down my spine... and "something" whispered to me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Blood, the moon, and transgression.
That is your fateful sin"—it said.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
All that remained within me... was an ecstasy so intense it blurred the line between myself and others.
And... an urge. A searing, voracious thirst to devour everything.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since then, everything began spiraling out of control...
Whenever a race began... *she* started showing up.
choice_data_list: (The way she was during the race...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Especially when competing against someone formidable... she goes completely wild.
Driven by sheer frenzy, losing all reason... and when I finally come to, I'm... all alone.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I... had already fallen completely under racing's spell.
Instead of walking away, I chose to suppress the madness... and as a result, I fractured.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The "I" who strives to remain rational.
And the "me" who runs on pure impulse, screaming to consume everything in her path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now I understood. Harboring two conflicting egos was why she seemed like an entirely different person. And torn apart by that inner conflict, she had been—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No... It's... strange, isn't it?
...I'm not normal. Something is terribly wrong with me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was true that by conventional standards, she might not fit the definition of "normal."
However, looking at it another way—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Special... Me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While it was easy to get overwhelmed by how bizarre it looked, the running she displayed—her speed, her raw power—was magnificent in every sense.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running was undeniably destructive, showing no regard for her own body or those around her.
Yet, if that power... if that raw instinct could be properly harnessed—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
............
Turn her... into a weapon...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...*gasp*. No... I can't...!
I mustn't let anyone see that side of me... never again...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Because... the way she runs is... hideous.
Indecent, shameless... a monster through and through.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You were terrified too, weren't you?
...You must have found me revolting—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shouted instinctively. It was true that I felt fear toward her.
Yet it wasn't born of malice, as she feared, but rather...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Voicing it made everything click. Why couldn't I take my eyes off her?
—Because I was completely, utterly enchanted by her demonic running.
choice_data_list: Let's find a way to control it together.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Are you truly sure? That girl... is beyond control.
She might... do something terrible to you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her crimson eyes locked onto mine, a ferocious shadow of "her" flickered past... sending a shiver down my spine.
Yet, as if feverish, words spilled from my mouth before I could even think.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My throat went dry. No matter what, I had to witness that running again...
—Even if it cost me everything, I wouldn't care.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
............Yes.
If so... then please... I place myself in your hands...
choice_data_list: First, maybe we try not bringing out that instinct...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...
May I... make a suggestion—
